tagline: Backend Developer & Project Manager · 4x Hackathon Winner
aboutText: I'm Joahan Samuel Morales Piña, a Backend Developer and Project Manager from Mexico City, currently studying Computer Engineering at IPN UPIICSA. I build scalable systems with Java + Spring Boot and ship AI prototypes with Python. I lead teams under pressure — 4 hackathon wins — and I run UPIIXIA, an AI club where we learn by shipping real projects.
workedOn: Backend, AI and full-stack — here are some favorites.
contactText: Open to backend / full-stack roles, freelance and hackathons. Fastest way to reach me is email.
lumiviaDesc: Eco-friendly routing backend (Java 17 + Spring Boot 3.3) with GraphHopper, OpenStreetMap, IDW spatial interpolation and computer vision. Deployed on IBM Cloud Code Engine. 1st place IBM Talent Land.
secretariaDesc: Geospatial model with Voronoi diagrams weighting foot traffic, transit, hotels, businesses and tourist flow to prioritize city zones by economic impact. 1st place SEDECO SecretarIA.
emotionDesc: Multimodal emotion recognition: Whisper for ASR, RoBERTuito for Spanish emotion classification, Wav2Vec2 for audio emotions, plus PCA, K-Means, correlations and visualizations.
handtrackDesc: AR drag-and-drop game with hand tracking for rehabilitation. Python + computer vision encouraging motor skills and coordination. 8 stars on GitHub.
mindvoiceDesc: Voice-based mental health assistant grounded in CBT using ElevenLabs, n8n and Redis for session orchestration. 3rd place + Best Project with Bolt.
metroDesc: Python + OpenCV tool to digitize subway networks and generate heatmaps from citizen reports. Open Source Category Winner, Austria hackathon.
ipnprofesDesc: Student-built platform to review professors and share academic resources, born out of UPIIXIA and used across the UPIICSA community. React + scraping.
timetablingDesc: Web timetabling system in Java (JSP, Servlets) with greedy scheduling that maximizes professor ratings while avoiding conflicts.
saesnotiDesc: Notifications tool for IPN SAES platform. TypeScript.
satautoDesc: Browser extension automating SAT tax forms (-50% time) plus a Java mobile app for inventory (-80% data loss) and Excel macros (-40% update time).
